name: Dr. Christopher B. Wong
notes: Tooth-and-pine-tree mark only; the practice has no wordmark asset (its header sets "Christopher B. Wong, DDS" in live type beside this mark). Vectorized (potrace) from the 280px PNG. Pair with the typeset name if the wall needs it to read.

name: Exquisite Dentistry
notes: Diamond mark + EXQUISITE / DENTISTRY wordmark from the live header PNG (413x76, gold mark + white type), vectorized with potrace at 8x and checked against the raster.

name: Olympic Bootworks
notes: Full-colour boot trinacria illustration converted to two-tone white: black linework 100%, colour fills 45%, paper-white areas knocked out. No wordmark asset exists (the site header sets "Olympic Bootworks" in live type next to the mark). Square; dense detail, so give it ~1.6x the height of wordmarks or pair with the typeset name.

name: Family First Smile Care
notes: Four overlapping pastel tooth figures; rendered as a white silhouette with the colour boundaries knocked out as thin lines so the figures stay separate. Mark only (site header sets the name in live type).

name: Town Centre Dental
notes: Generic tooth outline from the site icon (icon-512.png, also the JSON-LD logo). The site has no wordmark asset; its header is live type ("Town Centre Dental"). Consider the typographic fallback instead.

name: Grace Dental Santa Rosa
notes: Tooth + "Dr. Ji" script + "Grace Dental Santa Rosa" from the Webflow site logo (gold on transparent). Vectorized with potrace. The tagline line is small, so the lockup reads primarily as "Dr. Ji".

name: Roseville Dental Academy
notes: Circular academy seal with the name around the top. Converted by keying out the seal blue: black ring, type, icons and white shield become white, the gear scallops are knocked out, the laurel stays at ~35%. Seal type is small, so display at ~1.6x wordmark height (64-80px).

name: Rebellious Aging
notes: R-with-butterfly mark stacked over "Rebellious Aging", cropped from the site JSON-LD logo (the faint green glow behind the butterfly removed). Vectorized with potrace.

name: Wine Country Root Canal
notes: No logo asset exists: the site header is live serif type ("Wine Country Root Canal") and icon.svg is the stock Vercel/v0 placeholder. Render the name typographically.

name: Infobell IT Solutions
notes: Bell mark + Infobellit wordmark + "Advanced Technology Solutions" from the 5600px header PNG, vectorized. The bell clapper is a slightly lighter tint in the original; it is solid here.

name: Canary Foundation
source: https://canaryfoundation.org/opengraph.png (lockup cropped from the site OG image)
notes: Canary-in-circle over CANARY FOUNDATION, cropped from the site OG image. Dark ink becomes white and the yellow canary is knocked out of the disc. The site header itself only shows the circular mark.

name: Belize Kids
notes: BelizeKIDS.ORG wordmark with handprint from the site header (green/yellow on white, keyed to white). Vectorized. Very wide (~6.6:1), so cap its width.

name: Canary Cove
notes: Client's own vector logo (canary, cocktail glass, Canary Cove type) with colours collapsed to currentColor. An internal <mask> knocks out the white detail (lime segments, bubbles, the keyline around the C) and keeps the drink gradient as a fade; its mask fills are #fff/#000, which a mask needs. The canary reads as a solid silhouette because its green rim and yellow body merge, so the eye dot is lost. IDs are prefixed canary-cove-*, so the SVG can be inlined safely.

name: We Are Saplings
notes: Bear + sapling illustration over WE ARE SAPLINGS (watercolour artwork rendered as a white silhouette). Vectorized. Stacked and illustrative; the type is small relative to the art.

name: Coast Periodontics
notes: Client's own white-on-transparent lockup (CP circle mark + COAST PERIODONTICS & IMPLANT THERAPY). Kept as PNG because the circle carries a fine wave texture. The lockup says Implant Therapy, not Laser Surgery.

name: Practice Transitions Institute
notes: Triangle badge with the name inside and EXCELLENCE / INTEGRITY / PURPOSE on the sides, keyed from the white-background favicon-512 artwork (same as the site pti-logo.webp). Vectorized. Name type is small, so display at ~1.6x wordmark height.

name: Leadership Retreat
notes: "LR 26 / SAVANNAH GEORGIA" event mark: the yellow type was extracted from the photo-backed badge, and the flower photo background was dropped. It is year-specific (2026 edition). Vectorized.

name: Dental Strategies
notes: Dental Strategies lockup (gold/navy tooth-and-arrow mark, wordmark, "Excellence, Integrity, Purpose"), cropped from the site OG image (also its JSON-LD logo) and keyed to white. Vectorized.

name: Mataria Dental Group
notes: MDG monogram with wireframe implant + "Mataria Dental Group" from the white ("Branco") logo PNG. The thin wireframe softens at small sizes, so it stays PNG.

name: Waikiki Dental
notes: Hibiscus + outlined "Waikiki" + DENTAL from the site header PNG (511x73, the largest available). The outlined letters keep translucent fills (~40%) and the flower keeps its tonal detail, so it stays PNG. Low-res: display at 34px or less.

name: Sacramento Dental Medicine
notes: Three-figure mark over "Sacramento Dental Medicine" from the logo-full-on-dark PNG (278x209). Vectorized with potrace.
